newsitem.title: UK: ECC sees 12 mln stg costs, margins improving.
newsitem.headline: ECC sees 12 mln stg costs, margins improving.

text.p: British paper industry supplier English China Clays said on Friday it would incur cash costs of around 12 million pounds as part of a restructuring programme.
The company said the majority of the costs would be charged in the second half of 1996 and the remainder in 1997.

English China Clays said it had begun to benefit from its cost-cutting programme and said trading conditions had improved in the second half to date, helping trading margins. But mineral sales volumes remained below the year-earlier period.
